mapper.sql: select s.shipment_id,s.shipment_no,s.shipment_type,s.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,s.customer_name, s.shipment_date,s.status,s.total_qty,s.create_by,s.create_time,s.update_by,s.update_time,s.remark from wms_shipment s left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id
mapper.select: select s.shipment_id,s.shipment_no,s.shipment_type,s.warehouse_id,s.customer_name,s.shipment_date,s.status,s.total_qty, s.create_by,s.create_time,s.update_by,s.update_time,s.remark from wms_shipment s where s.shipment_id=#{shipmentId} for update

select l.line_id,l.shipment_id,l.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,l.location_id, p.location_code,p.location_name,l.batch_no,l.production_date,l.expiry_date,l.planned_qty,l.shipped_qty from wms_shipment_line l left join wms_item i on i.item_id=l.item_id left join wms_location p on p.location_id=l.location_id where l.shipment_id=#{shipmentId} order by l.line_id
mapper.delete: delete from wms_shipment where shipment_id=#{shipmentId} and status='DRAFT'
mapper.update: update wms_shipment set status='COMPLETED',total_qty=#{totalQty},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where shipment_id=#{shipmentId} and status='DRAFT'
update wms_shipment set status='CANCELLED',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where shipment_id=#{shipmentId} and status='DRAFT'
